basis: Third straight profitable quarter, net income $1.7m, but it leans on $4.3m of IEEPA tariff recoveries (an expected, sector-wide event), with sales down 8.7% and 'no material additional recoveries' expected. The forward signals are the positives: backlog up 6.2% yoy and 8.4% qoq (Hooker Branded +34.7%), a stronger July ex-recoveries and the Margaritaville ramp. The text gives no consensus. The repo's run notes say this name was traded around this print, but I know nothing of its move.
